gas_constant_source: Existing USGS1995 reference used elsewhere in this model; numerical R is not assigned to the Navarro table itself.
preexponential_divisor_meaning: A per second = exp(lnA) / supplied divisor; minutes is an unresolved alternative, not a source correction.
scope: Fixed published F1 parameters, no fitting. Reproduction at the fitted 2K/min and transfer to the other three recorded ramps. Plot intervals only; no experimental accuracy qualification.
